headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal eye versatile Dortmund forward Beier
description: Arsenal are monitoring Borussia Dortmund forward Maximilian Beier as a potential attacking reinforcement. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Man United's Michael Carrick concerned about Benjamin Sesko's latest injury
description: Michael Carrick has raised concerns about Benjamin Sesko's latest injury by revealing the problem is connected to the same shin issue which kept the striker sidelined for more than two months over the summer.

headline: Why this 3-week international break is longest ever (and why that's a good thing)
description: Fans have grown used to international games interrupting the club season, but this break will be a week longer than before. It's not as bad as it sounds.

headline: Carragher questions Wirtz future in Liverpool XI after latest struggles
description: Jamie Carragher has called on Andoni Iraola to drop Florian Wirtz for Liverpool's clash with Manchester City after describing the midfielder's display against Bournemouth as one of his worst since arriving at Anfield.

headline: Isak's winner lifts Liverpool to victory
description: Alexander Isak's second-half strike secures Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola a 1-0 victory over his former club Bournemouth.

headline: Manchester City score five in thrilling win over Sunderland
description: The Sky Blues remain top of the Premier League table after a goal-filled 5-3 victory over the Black Cats.
